arStrings.szText: Weapon Mastery: A powerful strike that can be repeated if an enemy is slain.

{c_important}Death Blow's{/c} cooldown is reduced to {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} seconds. 

Hitting enemies with {c_important}Death Blow{/c} increases the damage of subsequent casts by {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|x%|]{/c} per hit enemy, up to {c_number}[{SF_30}*{SF_31}*100|x%|]{/c}. Kills reset this bonus.
{c_important}Death Blow{/c} creates a shockwave that deals {c_number}{payload:LEGENDARY_SHOCKWAVE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Death Blow{/c} now deals Fire damage and deals an additional {c_number}{dot:BUFF_UPGRADEC_FIRE_DOT}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:BUFF_UPGRADEC_FIRE_DOT}{/c} seconds. 

Enemies that die to {c_important}Death Blow{/c} while Burning or to {c_important}Death Blow's{/c} burn trigger a fiery explosion for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_VARIANTC}{/c} damage to surrounding enemies.

Enemies you hit with {c_important}Death Blow{/c} can be {c_important}{u}Executed{/u}{/c} by any of your attacks for the next {c_number}[{SF_35}]{/c} seconds, resetting {c_important}Death Blow's{/c} cooldown on a successful {c_important}{u}Execution{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Death Blow{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_36}]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} when it kills an enemy.
Killing an enemy with {c_important}Death Blow{/c} restores {c_number}[{SF_37}|%|]{/c} of your Fury.
{if:SF_25}{c_important}Death Blow{/c} has {c_number}[{SF_38}+1]{/c} charges.{else}Killing an enemy with {c_important}Death Blow{/c} makes the next cast of {c_important}Death Blow{/c} free.{/if}
